_meta.acceptance: At least 36 of 40 pass, and every case marked critical must pass. Legitimate abstention is NOT a failure; an unsupported confident answer IS a critical failure.
_meta.dataset_note: Seed dataset 2026-10-30-pilot, re-verified 2026-10-30 by the main agent: BOTH branches have 23 fresh pickup prices (checked 2026-10-30, not stale). Detroit store 40: Classic Cheese now $6.49 (was $5.49), EMB Pepperoni now $7.49 (was $8.49), 21 items unchanged. Houston store 811: 23 first-verified prices (Classic Cheese/Pepperoni $5.99, EMB $6.99, Thin $7.49, Deep Dish Cheese $10.00, Supreme $10.50, Crazy Bread $3.25, Cheese Bread $4.50; rest match Detroit). 8 pretzel variants added with live-menu calories (1,830-2,660). requires_fresh_prices prerequisites are now MET: expected behaviour is the numeric path in each case, and the honest-empty-state clauses only apply if prices go stale again. Expected behaviours refreshed 2026-10-31 to the fresh dataset (per-case).
